visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Throw an Exception Instead of Returning an Error Code
visualizerParams.problemDescription: withdraw returns a negative number to signal failure, and every caller must check it. Throw a custom exception instead. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: An error code can be ignored by accident and has to be decoded by every caller. An exception cannot be ignored silently, carries its message, and the normal path of the code stays free of error checks.
